text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Pimples are caused by an 
irregular lifestyle. One should strive to 
maintain healthy daily habits—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In other words, are you saying I'm not 
disciplined or something?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, even if you're cracking down 
on rule-breakers, people are gonna say 
you're the one breaking school rules!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is a disgrace to the Disciplinary 
Committee!! I must fix my own discipline 
at once!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Bamboo Memory is suffering from 
rough skin.
